full_name: Akil Kumarasamy | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2024–2025 Fiction & Poetry Beatrice Shepherd Blane Fellow Rutgers University-Newark
bio: An assistant professor at Rutgers University–Newark, Akil Kumarasamy is a fiction writer and the author of Half Gods (Farrar, Straus and Giroux, 2018) and Meet Us by the Roaring Sea (Farrar, Straus and Giroux, 2022).
